svg.title: KIR2DL1–HLA-C2
svg.desc: Projected topology, not atomic docking. KIR contacts the peptide-binding platform; peptide and allotype affect recognition. Bw4 occurs on selected HLA-A as well as HLA-B. Native editable vector; domain cartoons are not atomic models.
